title: Rust: Recursive Descent Parser
description: Build a recursive descent parser that converts tokens into an AST.

steps.title: Define AST Nodes
steps.description: Define `ASTNode` enum with variants: `NumberLiteral(f64)`, `BinaryOp(Box<ASTNode>, TokenType, Box<ASTNode>)`, `Let(String, Box<ASTNode>)`, `Print(Box<ASTNode>)`, `Ident(String)`. Print node definitions.
hints: `enum ASTNode { NumberLiteral(f64), Ident(String), BinaryOp { left: Box<ASTNode>, op: TokenType, right: Box<ASTNode> }, ... }`
AST represents the syntactic structure of the program.

verification.failureMessage: Print the defined AST node types.

steps.title: Parse Numbers and Identifiers
steps.description: Create a `Parser` struct that takes tokens. Implement `parse_primary()` that handles Number and Ident tokens. Test with tokens from `"42"` and `"x"`.
hints: `fn parse_primary(&mut self) -> ASTNode { match self.peek().ttype { Number(n) => { self.advance(); ASTNode::NumberLiteral(n) }, ... } }`

verification.failureMessage: Parse a number token and print the AST node.

steps.title: Parse Binary Expressions
steps.description: Implement `parse_expression()` with operator precedence (PEMDAS). Handle `+`, `-`, `*`, `/` with proper associativity. Parse `"2 + 3 * 4"` and print the AST.
hints: Use precedence climbing or recursive descent for each level.
Higher precedence = deeper in the parse tree.

steps.title: Parse Let and Print Statements
steps.description: Add statement parsing: `let x = expr` and `print expr`. Parse `"let x = 42; print x + 1"` and print the AST.
hints: `Let` token → parse LetStatement, then expect Semicolon.

verification.failureMessage: Parse 'let x = 42; print x + 1' and print the full AST.

steps.title: AST Pretty Printer
steps.description: Implement `Display` for ASTNode that renders the tree with indentation. Show the hierarchy: each nesting level gets more indentation. Print the AST for a multi-statement program.
hints: `impl Display for ASTNode { fn fmt(&self, f: &mut Formatter) -> fmt::Result { ... } }`

verification.failureMessage: Parse a program and print the formatted AST.
